text:
incident-bot: ALERT: production kv-cache memory spike observed in us-west-2 serving cluster. error rate ↑ 4.2x for continuous-batching path. triggering pager for oncall rotation. paging channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime, #eng-sre.
ryan_oncall: on it. flipping to paging mode — collecting traces and live KV stats. tagging customers with high qps.
alice_runtime: seeing repeated cache growth on nodes that handled long prefix prompts. suspect reuse path holding stale seq offsets. logs show mismatched seq_id on reuse: expected 1203 but got 1187.
maya_sre: isolating affected nodes now, moving traffic to warm pool. starting canary with reuse disabled for 10% traffic.
eng-matt: quick config we can push: CONT_BATCH_REUSE=false per-route + reduce batch_window_ms from 12 -> 4 for the canary. also push KV_SEQ_VALIDATION=1 to log mismatches.
ryan_oncall: doing the canary config change via deploy-bot. /deploy configs continuous-batching canary reuse=false window=4 seq_check=1
deploy-bot: deploy started: continuous-batching canary (10%) — rolling config to us-west-2. ETA ~60s.
cs-liz: heads-up to affected customer accounts: three enterprise tenants saw 5xxs and delayed responses ~500-1200ms during the spike. raising P2 customer notifications.
alice_runtime: repro script: 
```
# quick reproduction snippet
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long-prefix>...","model":"rwd-13b"}' 
# observed: cached KV with seq offset mismatch after repeated prefix reuse
```

maya_sre: after canary flip: error rate on canary nodes dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. memory usage stable. non-canary still spiking.
ryan_oncall: decision: promote canary to 50% and keep reuse disabled cluster-wide if stable for 15m. notifying product + support.
eng-matt: adding a short-term guard: when KV_CACHE_SIZE > 2GB and reuse path triggers, evict by prefix-age instead of LRU to prevent blowup. patch ready, will roll in 20m.
cs-liz: pushing interim customer note: "We've identified a cache reuse bug impacting a subset of long-prefix workloads. We've applied a mitigation and are rolling further safeguards. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."
alice_runtime: found root cause hypothesis: under certain batched sequences the cached KV frame used a stale seq_offset because the reuse index wasn't reset on partial batch flush. this caused subsequent requests to replay older KV frames leading to cache growth and wrong token predictions.
maya_sre: running a targeted replay of affected requests against patched runtime in staging. metrics look good: no seq_mismatch logs and latency improves ~18%.
ryan_oncall: elevating to SEV-2: customer impact limited but reproducible and could affect latency SLAs. assigning postmortem owners: alice_runtime (root cause), eng-matt (hotfix), maya_sre (rollback/traffic), cs-liz (customer comms).
eng-matt: hotfix rollout plan: 1) add seq validation (KV_SEQ_VALIDATION=1) everywhere to catch mismatches 2) turn off reuse by default for 30m 3) roll in patch that resets reuse index on partial flush + prefix-age eviction. will perform blue-green to avoid cross-talk.
deploy-bot: hotfix phase 1 complete (seq validation enabled) — collecting mismatch logs to s3://redwood-ops/kv-seq-logs/2331123456/
alice_runtime: found ~1200 mismatch events in 10m window; correlates with nodes that served long-prefix customers. prepared a small runtime diff to reset reuse_index on partial batch flush. attaching diff in threads.
ryan_oncall: executing promotion to 50% canary now. monitor for error rate regressions + mem.
maya_sre: alert: one downstream app reported a transient 503 after promotion; looks like a misrouted health check. rolling back that node and draining.
eng-matt: pushing patch build v2026.3.1-hotfix. will run unit + integration tests, then stage deploy.
deploy-bot: build v2026.3.1-hotfix uploaded. starting canary deployment to staging then prod canary (10%).
cs-liz: coordinating targeted outreach to the three most impacted customers with mitigation timeline and ETA for full fix (~4 hrs estimate).
alice_runtime: test results: seq-offset resets and unit tests for reuse index pass. staging canary shows no regression under high long-prefix load.
ryan_oncall: approve prod rollout if no new alerts in 15m. teams standby.
maya_sre: post-rollout checklist: monitor kv-cache memory, seq_mismatch logs, 95th latency per-route, and customer error rates. set alert thresholds tighter: seq_mismatch > 5 in 10m -> auto rollback.
eng-matt: note: this is likely a correctness bug not just perf. plan to add additional invariant checks and e2e tests for partial-batch flush scenarios.
cs-liz: will prepare a customer-facing summary for later: timeline, impact, mitigation, next steps.
ryan_oncall: rolling to 100% now. initiating incident summary doc in /incidents/2331123456 and assigning postmortem slot tomorrow. thanks all — please keep logs and timelines in this thread for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
